I replied to Pree in our DM to confirm that Bay 42 is now her dock for Tansleigh Packaging pickups on the Quillon project.

I didn't save it to my persistent memory, because that memory is loaded into every conversation, including other members'. Rule 2 says something one member tells me in a DM must not show up in someone else's conversation. The note stays in her DM thread, and I told her I'll look there when she asks about pickups.
